project.title: tYDiSync~ PowerShell Cross-Platform Compatibility Project
project.objective: Ensure consistent functionality of PowerShell scripts across Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell Core (7+) on Windows, Linux, and macOS

testing_framework: Created comprehensive cross-platform testing framework with 5 test categories
Enhanced cross-platform-compatibility.ps1 with detailed test reporting
platform_detection: Developed PlatformDetection.psm1 module with reliable detection across all PowerShell versions
Created fallback mechanisms for detecting Linux/macOS without $IsLinux/$IsMacOS variables
Implemented edition detection using $PSVersionTable.PSEdition with fallbacks
Added robust OS detection using System.Runtime.InteropServices namespace
path_handling: Added Get-TempPath and Get-HomePath functions for cross-platform directories
Created New-PlatformPath for consistent path creation across platforms
Standardized on Join-Path for all path operations
error_handling: Standardized error handling with try-catch-finally blocks
Implemented proper error reporting and cleanup

platform_detection: Windows PowerShell 5.1 lacks $IsLinux and $IsMacOS automatic variables
$PSVersionTable.PSEdition is the most reliable way to detect PowerShell Core vs Windows PowerShell
System.Runtime.InteropServices namespace provides reliable OS detection in PowerShell Core
Environment detection requires multiple fallback mechanisms for maximum compatibility
path_handling: Path separators differ between platforms (backslash vs forward slash)
Join-Path provides the most reliable cross-platform path handling
Environment variables provide better portability than hardcoded paths
Path.DirectorySeparatorChar should be used for path separator detection
error_handling: Always use try-catch-finally blocks for critical operations
Implement standardized error logging with severity levels
Ensure resource cleanup in finally blocks

phases.name: Assessment
key_tasks: Run cross-platform tests on all supported platforms
Document platform-specific issues for each script

phases.name: Core Implementation
key_tasks: Import PlatformDetection.psm1 module in all critical scripts
Update file operation scripts to use platform-independent path handling
Implement robust error handling framework across all scripts
Create compatibility wrappers for PowerShell 7+ features

phases.name: Testing
key_tasks: Configure test environments for all target platforms
Run comprehensive tests on all platforms

phases.name: Documentation and Training
key_tasks: Update all script documentation with platform compatibility notes
Create developer guidelines for cross-platform PowerShell development
Conduct team training on cross-platform best practices
